payload.title: Evaluate semantic retrieval production readiness with preregistered operational and agent trials
acceptance: Freeze protocol before results; retain failures and source hashes
Exercise actual pinned E5 freshness, branch changes, concurrency, crash/restart, corrupt cache, bounds and path safety in isolated repositories
Measure larger-history agent quality against strong Markdown and same-encoder controls using frozen outcomes and replayable scoring
Report production verdict and missing real-user multiweek/host/platform evidence explicitly; no deployment or default enablement
